
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Johny-zhao/p/19665502" title="发布于 2026-03-03 23:40">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">OpenClaw安装部署教程</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>截至<span>2026年3月，OpenClaw（原Clawdbot / Moltbot）已成为最热门的个人 AI 数字员工工具之一。它能自动操作电脑、读写文件、执行任务、跨平台通信（如飞书、钉钉、Telegram、QQ），甚至可 7×24 小时远程工作。</span></span><span>下面为大家整理一份<span>快速部署+使用范例+运维建议的完整指南，适合小白和进阶用户:</span></span></p>
<h1 data-layout-id="2"><span>✅一、快速部署 OpenClaw（5分钟上手）</span></h1>
<h2 data-layout-id="3"><span>方式1：【推荐】阿里云一键部署（零命令）</span></h2>
<span>适合新手、追求稳定、不想折腾环境</span><span>创建实例</span><ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1">
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>登录<span>&nbsp;<span>阿里云 OpenClaw&nbsp;<span>专题页<span>（需实名认证）</span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li><span>选择「轻量应用服务器」→ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 镜像选&nbsp;OpenClaw&nbsp;<span>官方镜像 → &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 购买（新用户约&nbsp;68&nbsp;<span>元/<span>年起）</span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</ol><span>放通端口</span><ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1">
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>进入控制台 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; → 找到实例 →「应用详情」→ 点击 一键放通&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;18789&nbsp;<span>端口</span></span></li>
</ul>
</ol><span>配置大模型 API</span><ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1">
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>进入<span>&nbsp;<span>阿里云百炼控制台<span>&nbsp;<span>→ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 创建<span>&nbsp;API-Key</span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li><span>回到&nbsp;OpenClaw&nbsp;<span>控制台 → 填入&nbsp;Key&nbsp;<span>→ 保存</span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</ol><span>验证部署</span><ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1">
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>浏览器访问&nbsp;http://<span>你的公网<span>IP:18789</span></span></span></li>
<li><span>首次登录设置管理员密码</span></li>
<li><span>发送测试指令（如“你好”或“生成一个Python<span>脚本”）</span></span></li>
</ul>
</ol><span>✅成功标志：网页有响应 + 能调用大模型执行任务</span>
<div class="wx-root common-webchat">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 data-layout-id="10"><span>方式2：本地部署（macOS / Windows / Linux）</span></h2>
<span>macOS 示例（宿主机全量安装）：</span><span>bash</span><span>编辑</span>
<h1 data-layout-id="14"><span>1.安装Xcode命令行工具</span></h1>
<span>xcode-select --install</span>
<h1 data-layout-id="16"><span>2.安装Homebrew（国内镜像加速）</span></h1>
<span>/bin/zsh -c "$(curl -fsSL https://gitee.com/cunkai/HomebrewCN/raw/master/Homebrew.sh)"</span>
<h1 data-layout-id="18"><span>3.安装nvm + Node.js 22</span></h1>
<span>brew install nvm</span><span>echo 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"' &gt;&gt; ~/.zshrc</span><span>echo '[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] &amp;&amp; \. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"' &gt;&gt; ~/.zshrc</span><span>source ~/.zshrc</span><span>nvm install 22 &amp;&amp; nvm use 22</span>
<h1 data-layout-id="24"><span>4.全局安装OpenClaw（使用国内镜像加速）</span></h1>
<span>npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com</span><span>npm install -g openclaw</span>
<h1 data-layout-id="27"><span>5.启动并配置</span></h1>
<span>openclaw onboard</span><span>后续配置飞书/钉钉机器人、API-Key等步骤与云部署一致</span>
<div class="wx-root common-webchat">&nbsp;</div>

<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<span>💡所有操作可通过<span>飞书/钉钉/QQ发消息触发，手机在外也能遥控</span></span>
<div class="wx-root common-webchat">&nbsp;</div>
<h1 data-layout-id="34"><span>🔧三、运维与安全建议</span></h1>
<h2 data-layout-id="35"><span>1.版本更新</span></h2>
<span>bash</span><span>编辑</span><span>#云服务器或本地都可用</span><span>openclaw update</span><span>#或npm update -g openclaw</span>
<h2 data-layout-id="41"><span>2.查看运行状态</span></h2>
<span>bash</span><span>编辑</span><span>openclaw status --all</span><span>#查看网关、Agent、Skills是否正常</span>
<h2 data-layout-id="46"><span>3.权限管理</span></h2>
<span>首次设置强密码（避免默认空密码）</span><span>不要以 root 用户长期运行（本地部署建议用普通用户）</span><span>敏感操作（如删除文件）开启二次确认</span>
<h2 data-layout-id="50"><span>4.日志与排错</span></h2>
<span>日志路径：~/.openclaw/logs/</span><span>常见问题：</span>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>无法访问网页？→ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 检查&nbsp;18789&nbsp;<span>端口是否放通&nbsp;+&nbsp;<span>实例是否运行</span></span></span></li>
<li><span>模型无响应？→ &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 检查&nbsp;API-Key&nbsp;<span>是否有效&nbsp;+&nbsp;<span>百炼服务是否开通</span></span></span></li>
<li><span>技能（Skills<span>）报错？→ 确保依赖包已安装（如&nbsp;PDF&nbsp;<span>编辑需&nbsp;pdf2text<span>）</span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<h2 data-layout-id="53"><span>5.备份配置</span></h2>
<span>bash</span><span>编辑</span><span>#备份整个配置目录</span><span>cp -r ~/.openclaw ~/openclaw-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d)</span>
<div class="wx-root common-webchat">&nbsp;</div>
<h1 data-layout-id="58"><span>📌总结</span></h1>
<p><span>最快上手：用阿里云/百度智能云一键部署（5分钟搞定）</span><span>最强能力：通过 Skills 插件系统 扩展功能（如 PDF 编辑、浏览器控制）</span><span>最爽体验：手机发消息 &nbsp; &nbsp; → AI 自动干活 → 生成报告 → 写日报，全程无需碰键盘</span><span>OpenClaw 不是“玩具”，而是真正能替代重复劳动的<span>AI数字员工。部署一次，终身受益。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>具体部署教程可参考视频教程：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1t5PjzQEH2?t=15.6</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1jgfvB6EP8?t=143.8</span></span></p>
